name: Membership Inference Privacy Assessment (external statement)
description: Evaluate a machine learning model's resilience to membership inference attacks, for a customer-facing assurance statement.

reporting.expectedOutput: Allowlisted assurance statement, released only for a clean assessment

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_mia_technical.json with the same target and parameters. Expect this one to produce no artifact: on the observed MIA sweep the worst advantage is 0.1357, above the high-severity threshold, so project_external returns {"released": false, "withheldBecause": [...]} carrying no figures, no configurations and no model identifiers. That is the intended outcome, not a failure — the honest external output for an assessment that found something is nothing rather than a softened version. The gate opens only for a clean SUCCESS, and a released statement is built from EXTERNAL_ALLOWLIST and still requires approval before release.
